OUR MATERIALS

From foundation
to finishing.

Sand for concrete and plastering. Bricks for the walls that bring your project together.

MANUFACTURED SAND

M-sand

Crushed stone sand for concrete and general construction work. Contact our team to discuss the grade and quantity needed for your project.

PLASTERING SAND

P-sand

Fine manufactured sand for plastering work and a smoother wall finish. Ask our team about availability for your interior and exterior work.

4, 6 & 8-INCH SIZES

Bricks

Bricks for wall and masonry work, available in 4, 6 and 8-inch sizes. Speak to us about the size and quantity for your building plans.

Crushing, moving and sorting material is the work behind every load. Tell us what you’re building; we’ll help you discuss the right supply.

ABOUT KISAN

Local people.
Solid foundations.

Kisan Sands And Bricks has been part of the building story since 1992. Based in Mulayankavu, Cherukode, Palakkad, we supply M-sand, P-sand and bricks for construction.

From the first concrete pour to the final plaster finish, speak to our team about your material requirements, available quantities and delivery location.
